review_candidates.title: Data Systems Senior Systems Architect/Engineer
review_candidates.description: Requisition Id 17449 Overview The Environmental Sciences Division (ESD) at Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL) is seeking a Data Systems Senior Systems Architect/Engineer for its Earth Sciences Informatics portfolio. In this role, you will design, deploy, and maintain facility-wide infrastructure that supports high-performance computing (HPC), research, instrumentation, engineering, and operational workloads across a collaborative network spanning nine DOE National Laboratories for the Atmospheric Radiation Measurement (ARM) Facility. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of national security, scientific research, and cutting-edge infrastructure engineering. In this role you will design, implement, and maintain the data, compute, storage, virtualization, security controls, and networking infrastructure that supports BER scientific data programs and facilities. As a technical lead on projects spanning the national laboratory complex, you will ensure interoperability, security, and performance while collaborating with partner labs to meet research and operational needs. You will architect high-availability and disaster recovery solutions, monitor system health proactively, and maintain compliance with DOE orders, NIST 800-53, and FISMA. You will automate provisioning and patching with tools like Ansible, Puppet, or Terraform, support the integration of HPC clusters, AI infrastructure, and storage systems such as NFS, GPFS and Ceph. As part of this role, you will be actively collaborating with diverse teams and mentoring junior staff. The ARM Data Center processes, archives, and distributes atmospheric observations from observatories around the globe, and provides data, computing and AI infrastructure, and analysis tools to the scientific community. Your work will directly improve how our community accesses and uses vast quantity of atmospheric and earth science data. Major Duties/Responsibilities Design, implement, and maintain facility-wide systems infrastructure including compute, storage, virtualization, and networking environments supporting DOE BER data programs and facilities. Serve as a technical lead for infrastructure projects coordinated across the national laboratory complex, ensuring interoperability, security, and performance standards are met facility-wide. Work with distributed teams to enable data collection, secure transfer, data processing, and distribution. Architect and support high-availability and disaster recovery solutions for mission-critical systems. Collaborate with engineers, scientists, and IT staff at partner national laboratories to align infrastructure strategy with research and operational requirements. Monitor system performance, capacity, and health; proactively identify and resolve issues before they impact operations. Research new and emerging technologies and successfully design and deploy for data center operations. Implement and maintain security controls in compliance with DOE orders, NIST 800-53, FISMA, and other applicable federal cybersecurity frameworks. Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and patching using tools such as Ansible, Puppet, or Terraform. Support integration of HPC clusters, AI infrastructure, data storage systems (e.g., NFS, GPFS, Ceph), and networking (including high-speed interconnects) for facility operations. Address critical incidents affecting data center operations and/or interlab connectivity. Develop and maintain detailed system documentation, standard operating procedures, and disaster recovery plans. Mentor junior engineers and contribute to a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement. Basic Qualifications BS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 5+ years of experience in systems engineering, data center operations, or enterprise infrastructure roles. Strong hands-on experience with Linux/Unix and Windows Server administration at scale. Deep understanding of virtualization technologies (VMware, KVM, or similar). Experience with enterprise storage systems, SAN/NAS architectures, and backup/DR solutions Solid networking knowledge (TCP/IP, VLANs, routing/switching, firewalls). Experience working within federal or DOE cybersecurity compliance frameworks (NIST 800-53, RMF, FISMA). Demonstrated ability to work across distributed, multi-site organizations and manage competing stakeholder priorities. Excellent troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting HPC environments or scientific computing infrastructure. Familiarity with DOE National Laboratory systems, governance, or interlab collaboration models. Experience with configuration management and infrastructure-as-code (Ansible, Terraform, Puppet, Chef). Relevant certifications (e.g., RHCE, CISSP, VCP, or equivalent). Experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes, OpenShift) in a research or federal environment. Special Requirements Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. For employment at Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL), a Real ID compliant form of identification will be required. Additionally, ORNL is subject to Department of Energy (DOE) access restrictions. All employees must also be able to obtain and maintain a federal Personal Identity Verification (PIV) card as mandated by Homeland Security Presidential Directive 12 (HSPD-12) and Department of Energy (DOE) Order 473.1A, which requires a favorable post-employment background investigation. To obtain this credential, new employees must successfully complete and pass a Federal Tier 1 background check investigation. This investigation includes a declaration of illegal drug activities, including use, supply, possession, or manufacture within the last year. This includes marijuana and cannabis derivatives, which are still considered illegal under federal law, regardless of state laws. About ORNL As a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) Office of Science national laboratory, ORNL has an impressive 80-year legacy of addressing the nation’s most pressing challenges. Our team is made up of over 7,000 dedicated and innovative individuals! Our goal is to create an environment where a variety of perspectives and backgrounds are valued, ensuring ORNL is known as a top choice for employment. These principles are essential for supporting our broader mission to drive scientific breakthroughs and translate them into solutions for energy, environmental, and security challenges facing the nation. ORNL offers competitive pay and benefits programs to attract and retain individuals who demonstrate exceptional work behaviors. The laboratory provides a range of employee benefits, including medical and retirement plans and flexible work hours, to support the well-being of you and your family. Employee amenities such as on-site fitness, banking, and cafeteria facilities are also available for added convenience. Other benefits include the following: Prescription Drug Plan, Dental Plan, Vision Plan, 401(k) Retirement Plan, Contributory Pension Plan, Life Insurance, Disability Benefits, Generous Vacation and Holidays, Parental Leave, Legal Insurance with Identity Theft Protection, Employee Assistance Plan, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, Wellness Programs, Educational Assistance, Relocation Assistance, and Employee Discounts. This position will remain open for a minimum of 5 days after which it will close when a qualified candidate is identified and/or hired. We accept Word (.doc, .docx), Adobe (unsecured .pdf), Rich Text Format (.rtf), and HTML (.htm, .html) up to 5MB in size. Resumes from third party vendors will not be accepted; these resumes will be deleted and the candidates submitted will not be considered for employment. If you have trouble applying for a position, please email ORNLRecruiting@ornl.gov. ORNL is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants, including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans, are encouraged to apply. UT-Battelle is an E-Verify employer.

review_candidates.description: Title: NOC (EXACTAC) Analyst Requisition ID#: 5186 Location: Austin, TX, US, 78735 Property: Exacta Pay Range: Market Competitive At Exacta Systems, we’re not just shaping the future of gaming—we’re redefining it. As a leader in historical horse racing (HHR) technology, we create cutting-edge gaming solutions that power thrilling player experiences nationwide. Now part of the Churchill Downs family, we’re backed by a storied legacy of excellence in racing and gaming. This new chapter brings exciting opportunities for growth, stability, innovation, and impact. If you're looking for a career where technology meets tradition and where your ideas drive the future, let’s explore the possibilities together! Job Summary The NOC Analyst supports the availability, reliability, and performance of Exacta Systems’ production technology environment and customer-facing systems. This position provides proactive monitoring, incident triage, troubleshooting, escalation, and resolution support for network, infrastructure, hardware, application, and gaming-system issues while helping maintain Exacta’s 24x7 business operations. There are two positions open, and these will serve as 2nd and 3rd shift support on our customer-facing EXACTAC team. During second and third shifts, the NOC Analyst serves as a primary point of contact for internal and external customers experiencing network, system, infrastructure, and Exacta application or game-related issues when on-site staffing is reduced. The Analyst responds to inbound calls and alerts, documents and prioritizes incidents, troubleshoots issues with customers and vendors, and coordinates with technical teams to restore service as quickly as possible. This is a customer-facing technical role requiring strong troubleshooting ability, sound judgment, effective communication under pressure, and the ability to manage multiple incidents, alerts, and support channels simultaneously. Essential Duties And Responsibilities Network Operations & Monitoring Monitor Exacta’s network, infrastructure, systems, applications, and gaming environments to support reliable 24x7 operations. Monitor dashboards and tools such as SolarWinds, Splunk, LogicMonitor, and other platforms for alerts, anomalies, outages, and performance issues. Respond to inbound calls, chats, emails, monitoring alerts, and ticket requests involving network, hardware, system, and application issues. Perform routine operational monitoring, including backup verification, log reviews, system health checks, and infrastructure status reporting. Identify recurring incidents or performance trends and escalate findings for root-cause analysis and corrective action. Maintain accurate shift logs and provide clear handoffs of open incidents, risks, and outstanding work to incoming team members. Incident Management & Technical Support Triage, troubleshoot, document, and resolve incidents within the appropriate level of responsibility and established Service Level Agreements. Serve as a primary technical contact for customers and vendors during assigned shifts. Work assigned tickets through resolution or appropriate escalation while maintaining timely and accurate documentation. Participate in incident and change-management conference bridges as required. Support root-cause analysis by gathering technical information, documenting findings, and assisting Operations and customers as needed. Provide clear verbal and written technical input for Incident and Change Management activities. Coordinate with vendors and internal technical teams to resolve hardware, software, network, and application issues. Infrastructure & Change Management Troubleshoot and support network, infrastructure, connectivity, and system issues affecting Exacta operations or customer environments. Monitor infrastructure availability and performance and provide regular operational reporting. Support planned infrastructure changes within Exacta’s established Change Control framework. Assist with configuration, maintenance, and operational support of network and infrastructure technologies within the NOC’s area of responsibility. Help ensure changes are appropriately documented, communicated, and validated. Customer & Cross-Functional Support Communicate directly with Exacta customers through telephone, ticketing, email, and other established support channels. Maintain professional, clear, and timely communication during outages and other high-impact incidents. Serve as an operational interface between Exacta and Churchill Downs Incorporated IT teams, including NOC, Infrastructure, Development, Information Security, System Services, and other technical groups. Escalate incidents appropriately based on severity, customer impact, technical complexity, and established procedures. Maintain effective working relationships with customers, vendors, Field Operations, Engineering, and other internal teams. Continuous Improvement & Development Identify recurring issues, operational trends, and opportunities to improve monitoring, troubleshooting, documentation, and incident response. Maintain current knowledge of Exacta systems, network environments, infrastructure, and gaming applications relevant to NOC responsibilities. Stay informed on emerging technologies and products and pursue relevant technical training or certifications as appropriate. Contribute to the continuous improvement of NOC procedures, documentation, monitoring practices, and service delivery. Perform other duties as assigned. Required Skills And Abilities Working knowledge of IT operations, service desk/NOC practices, network infrastructure, connectivity, and performance monitoring. Ability to diagnose, triage, troubleshoot, and appropriately escalate network, hardware, system, and application issues. Familiarity with monitoring platforms such as SolarWinds, Splunk, LogicMonitor, or comparable technologies. Knowledge of Windows and Linux-based environments preferred. Experience with Cisco and Aruba WAN/LAN switching and routing technologies preferred. Familiarity with firewalls, packet-capture technologies such as Wireshark or Netscout, and network troubleshooting concepts preferred. Experience with call-center telephone systems and call routing, including ACD/IVR, is a plus. Scripting knowledge or experience is preferred. Strong verbal and written communication skills, particularly when communicating technical information during high-pressure incidents. Ability to simultaneously manage calls, tickets, monitoring alerts, and competing priorities. Strong customer-service orientation and ability to communicate professionally with customers, vendors, and internal technical teams. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently during periods of reduced staffing while recognizing when escalation is required. Ability to be licensed as an employee by applicable racing and gaming jurisdictions in which Exacta operates. Unrestricted authorization to work in the United States. Education And Experience Minimum of 1 year of experience in a Network Operations Center, IT Help Desk, Service Desk, technical support, or similar IT operations environment required. Associate or bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Networking, Computer Science, or a related discipline preferred; relevant technical certifications or equivalent professional experience considered. Experience with IT operations, network infrastructure, connectivity, system monitoring, and technical troubleshooting. Experience with ticketing systems and incident-management processes. Experience supporting production or customer-facing technology environments preferred. HHR, casino gaming, or other regulated technology-industry experience is preferred but not required. ITIL Foundation certification or comparable service-management knowledge is a plus.
